monsters.name: Furnace Cog-Automaton
monsters.description: Ancient derelict clockwork automaton with a glowing coal furnace in its belly, spewing suffocating steam and clanking gears.
monsters.weakness: Weak to frost/blunt — crack the coal furnace with Starlight Blade or Whisk Hammer

monsters.name: Magma Magnesnail
monsters.description: Molten magnetic snail with a shell attracting scrap metal, crawling steadily through subterranean magma veins.
monsters.weakness: Weak to impact — Mystic Scythe or Whisk Hammer shatters magnetic carapace

monsters.name: Steam-Mole Driller
monsters.description: Mechanized mole wearing a brass hardhat drill, burrowing beneath granite bedrock to throw boulders upward.
monsters.weakness: Weak to light — Spirit Lantern blinds and repels it

monsters.name: Gloom-Root Strangler
monsters.description: Corrupted ancient roots entrapping wayward wanderers; its crown blossom bursts with disorienting spore pollen.
monsters.weakness: Weak to fire/light — incinerate tangles with bright fire strikes

monsters.name: Nectar Phantasm Moth
monsters.description: Enchanting silk moth with embroidered wings, fluttering downward to snatch sweet honey and fresh tea leaves from pouches.
monsters.weakness: Weak to ranged light — Spirit Lantern bursts clip its wings

monsters.name: Bramble Puck
monsters.description: Mischievous moss sprite sporting a mushroom cap, hurling mud pellets and tugging at witch hats.
monsters.weakness: Weak to area sweeps — Mystic Scythe clears swarms effortlessly

monsters.name: Astral Hollow Knight
monsters.description: Empty animated white marble armor patrolling to clocktower chimes, swinging a broadsword that casts crystal shockwaves.
monsters.weakness: Weak to armor-breaking slams — Whisk Hammer shatters marble plate

monsters.name: Grimoire Mimic
monsters.description: Brass-bound spell grimoire with fanged pages, fluttering furiously and chanting stunning ancient runes.
monsters.weakness: Weak to fast melee — Starlight Blade 3-hit rhythm combo

monsters.name: Mirror-Glass Raven
monsters.description: Giant corvid whose feathers are slivers of fractured mirrors, reflecting celestial starlight to blind intruders.
monsters.weakness: Weak to light/impact — Spirit Lantern cracks mirror wings

monsters.name: Solar Gryphon
monsters.description: Majestic chimera of white clouds and radiant sunlight, guardian of the Tree of Longevity in the celestial clouds.
monsters.weakness: Weak to heavy strikes — requires high-tier enchanted gear & agile dodging

monsters.name: Aurora Stag
monsters.description: Sacred celestial stag whose majestic antlers are living ribbons of aurora dancing across the night sky.
monsters.weakness: Weak to celestial starlight — requires high-grade Starlight weaponry

monsters.name: Poltergeist Kettle
monsters.description: Haunted antique copper kettle hovering through old mine shafts, whistling loudly and venting scalded herbal steam.
monsters.weakness: Weak to light/impact — Spirit Lantern + Starlight Blade

monsters.name: Dark Crystal Scarab
monsters.description: Subterranean beetle whose carapace is a jagged cluster of dark smoky quartz, clinging to cave walls.
monsters.weakness: Weak to blunt force — Whisk Hammer pulverizes its crystal shell
